name: Windshield Wipers
instructions: Hang from a bar or lie on the floor with arms out, legs raised vertical.
Keeping the legs straight, rotate them to one side.
Lower as far as you can control, then sweep to the other side.
Move like a windshield wiper. Elite oblique and core control.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: An advanced just your bodyweight core exercise for the abs. Windshield Wipers builds the trunk stability that underpins safe movement as you age.
